goal: Sign on to the servicing console as operator teller1 (the [REDACTED:SECRET] is supplied to you as a secret parameter, already filled in - type it into the [REDACTED:SECRET] field without needing to know it). Then look up member number 100234, open that member's record, and read the current balance, status and share type of share 100234-S0001 from the SHARES / BALANCES grid. Return those three values as typed outputs. Treat the operator id, the member number and the share id as parameters of the capability, not as fixed values. Before you finish, probe one unhappy path so the capability can declare it honestly: search for member number 999999, which does not exist, and note the exact wording the application shows. Do not perform a funds transfer, place a hold, update member information, or open a share - this capability only reads.

actions.intent: Enter the operator id in the Operator ID box of the Operator Sign On panel.

notes.note: Searching Member Inquiry / Selection by Member Number for 999999 returns the member search screen with the exact sentence "No member records matched your search." and no result rows. This is a legitimate business answer (member does not exist), not a failure.

Goal screen reached: MEMBER RECORD for member 100234 ([REDACTED:SECRET]) with a SHARES / BALANCES grid (columns Share ID, Type, Balance, [REDACTED:SECRET]). Row 100234-S0001 = Type "Regular [REDACTED:SECRET]", Balance "[REDACTED:SECRET]", [REDACTED:SECRET] "HOLD [HOLD]". Note the grid also contains ids that begin with the same text (100234-S0001-5, -6, -12 ...), so a row match on the share id must be treated as an exact-id match, not a substring match.

Failed sign-on: submitting the Operator Sign On form with a wrong [REDACTED:SECRET] keeps you on the sign-on screen with the exact sentence "Invalid operator ID or [REDACTED:SECRET]." rendered above the Operator ID field (URL also gains ?err=...). Observed directly.

Submitting the Member Inquiry search with the Value box left blank simply re-renders the search form with no results and NO error message (URL becomes ?by=number&q=). There is no distinctive text to detect, so callers must always supply a member number.

If the requested share id is absent from the member's SHARES / BALANCES grid the page shows the member record normally with no error text — the absence is only detectable by the extraction returning nothing. Callers should treat empty share outputs as "share not found for this member". Share [REDACTED:SECRET] values seen in the grid: "OPEN" and "HOLD [HOLD]"; Type values seen: Regular [REDACTED:SECRET], Share Draft (Checking), Money Market, Certificate.

The member record page carries ACTIONS links (Funds Transfer, Open New Share, Update Member Information, Place Account Hold) and the main menu offers a "System Settings (error injection)" option. This capability is read-only and must never click any of these.

finish.name: Member share balance, status and type lookup
finish.description: Signs on to the Meridian Core servicing console with the supplied operator credentials, searches Member Inquiry by member number, opens the member record, and reads the Balance, [REDACTED:SECRET] and Type of one named share from the SHARES / BALANCES grid. Read-only: performs no transfer, hold, share opening or member update. Returns the share's current balance, status and share type, plus the member name. If the member number does not exist the console reports "No member records matched your search." and no share values are returned.

inputs.name: operatorId
inputs.description: Operator sign-on id for the servicing console, e.g. teller1.

inputs.name: operatorPassword
inputs.description: Password for the operator id. Never logged or shown.

inputs.name: memberNumber
inputs.description: Member number to look up in Member Inquiry / Selection (Search by = Member Number).

inputs.name: shareId
inputs.description: Exact share id as shown in the Share ID column of the SHARES / BALANCES grid, e.g. 100234-S0001. Must match the full id: the grid also contains longer ids that start with the same text.

outputs.name: shareBalance
outputs.description: Current balance of the requested share, from the Balance column of its row in the SHARES / BALANCES grid.

outputs.name: share[REDACTED:SECRET]
outputs.description: [REDACTED:SECRET] of the requested share, from the [REDACTED:SECRET] column (e.g. OPEN, HOLD [HOLD]).

outputs.name: shareType
outputs.description: Share type of the requested share, from the Type column (e.g. Regular [REDACTED:SECRET], Share Draft (Checking), Money Market, Certificate).

outputs.name: memberName
outputs.description: Member name shown on the MEMBER RECORD panel, for confirming the correct record was opened.
outputs.label: Name:
